name: Type 98 No. 25 250 kg land bomb
blurb: The bomb every Japanese bomber in the game carries. Its model is generated from the U.S. Army's postwar manual on Japanese ordnance.
history:
The Type 98 No. 25 was the Imperial Japanese Navy's 250 kg general-purpose land bomb, adopted in 1938. A cast steel nose and a welded and riveted steel body carried about 96 kg of picric acid or Type 98 explosive, with a sheet-steel tail cone and four fins braced by box struts.

It was painted gray, with a green nose band and green tail struts. Carrier dive bombers such as the D3A Val carried bombs of this class against ships and airfields from Pearl Harbor onward.
